description: MMS gate: run the inline esm-spec 6.6 tests of problems/heat_1d_nonuniform_neumann.esm (model Heat, test mms_nonuniform_neumann_decay) at the problem's default resolution (N=64) through each binding's official simulation pathway. Exercises the conservative finite-volume non-uniform Neumann Laplacian rule central_D2_nonuniform_neumann_bc on the quadratic-stretch mesh with the manufactured mode x + exp(-alpha pi^2 t) cos(pi x) and inhomogeneous walls qL=qR=1 (the unit wall gradient of the ramp x, which the discrete operator annihilates exactly); the x-shaped geometry observeds xc and dxw are re-derived from N. The assertions and their tolerances live in the problem file itself; this manifest only routes the runners.

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
